5. Are the plaintiffs entitled to get the decree as prayed for? " 

 6. The plaintiffs being aggrieved preferred Title Appeal No. 231 of 1999 in the Court of District Judge, Dhaka, which on transfer was heard and disposed of by the Additional District Judge, Court No.8, Dhaka, allowing the appeal setting aside the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court declaring the decision for allotment of lands in favour of the defendant-petitioners hereof illegal and that the plaintiff respondents hereof are entitled to allotment of the lands measuring of 26 decimals described in the schedule B to the plaint.
